externalChecks.title: Examples of usage distinctions for kanji sharing a Japanese reading
externalChecks.scope: Entry 007, printed p.5, PDF p.9, inspected by extracting the actual PDF text.
externalChecks.supports: The entry explicitly covers the adjectives and both verbs: 温 for not-cold and affectionate uses, including soup; 暖 for not-cold ambient conditions, mainly weather/air temperature, including warmed air and heating a room. This supports qualified spelling guidance and food/room contrasts, not exclusive semantic compartments.
externalChecks.doesNotEstablish: The inspected entry does not explicitly prescribe the spelling for warming the body or hands. No such preference is asserted in the revised cards.

reviewEvidence.limits: Quiz guards use actual displayed labels and taught uses, not unrestricted Japanese interchangeability. Four direct pairs are added; symmetry is provided by the app, not transitivity. Body/hand examples were replaced with uncontroversial room and food/drink contexts without declaring their old spellings incorrect.
